sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Understand the fundamental concepts of control and coordination in living organisms.
Explore the structure and function of the nervous system and neurons.
Learn about reflex actions and the reflex arc.
Discover the parts and functions of the human brain.
Examine coordination and movement mechanisms in plants.
Identify key plant and animal hormones and their roles.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary section with avatar and bullet points for learning goals.

sections.title: Introduction to Control and Coordination
learning_goals: Define control and coordination in biological systems.
Explain the role of stimuli in initiating responses.
Differentiate between the nervous and endocrine systems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Conceptual explanation of fundamental terms and systems, suitable for animated text and diagrams.

sections.title: The Animal Nervous System and Neurons
learning_goals: Describe the basic structure of a neuron.
Explain how nerve impulses are transmitted.
Distinguish between sensory and motor neurons.
Understand the concepts of voluntary and involuntary actions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Detailed explanation of neuron structure and function, ideal for animated diagrams and flowcharts.

sections.title: Reflex Action and the Reflex Arc
learning_goals: Define reflex action and its significance.
Trace the pathway of a reflex arc.
Identify the components of a reflex arc (receptor, effector, spinal cord).
Differentiate between reflex actions and voluntary actions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Process-oriented content, best visualized with animated diagrams showing the pathway of a reflex arc.

sections.title: Structure and Function of the Human Brain
learning_goals: Identify the major parts of the human brain (fore-brain, mid-brain, hind-brain).
Describe the specific functions of the cerebrum, cerebellum, medulla, and pons.
Understand how different brain regions coordinate bodily functions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Complex anatomical structure and functional mapping, requiring detailed animated diagrams and labels.

sections.title: Coordination and Movement in Plants
learning_goals: Explain tropic movements in plants.
Differentiate between positive and negative tropism.
Provide examples of how shoots and roots respond to stimuli.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Plant movements are dynamic and best shown through time-lapse or real-world video examples to illustrate tropism.

sections.title: Plant Hormones and Their Functions
learning_goals: List the major plant hormones (Auxin, Gibberellin, Cytokinins, Abscisic Acid).
Describe the primary function of each plant hormone.
Understand how plant hormones regulate growth and development.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Presenting factual information and their effects, can be effectively shown with animated text and simple diagrams illustrating hormone action.

sections.title: Animal Hormones and the Endocrine System
learning_goals: Define hormones and their role in animals.
Identify key endocrine glands (Hypothalamus, Pituitary, Thyroid, Adrenal, Pancreas).
Explain the function of hormones like Insulin in regulating bodily processes.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Illustrating the location of glands and their hormonal outputs is well-suited for animated anatomical diagrams.
